raw_segments.text: Yes, Helgham and Gertrude have been friends ever since the day that he acted upon her
advice in the little matter with Gunhild.
When Gertrude heard the racket in the schoolroom, she said,
"'You're just in time to see something new, Helgham.
It would seem that henceforth the children are to instruct the schoolmaster.'"
Then Helgham laughed, for he comprehended that this sort of thing was ludicrous.
He promptly drove the children out and abolished the nuisance.
